'''''Woodwardia radicans''''', the '''chain fern''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17}}</ref> '''European chain fern''' or '''rooting chainfern''', is a [[species]] of [[fern]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] Blechnaceae, mainly found in [[Macaronesia]] and southwestern Europe, but is also found in southern [[Italy]] and [[Crete]]. Growing to {{convert|1.8|m|ft|0|abbr=on}} tall by {{convert|2|m|ft|0|abbr=on}} broad, it is [[evergreen]] with arching fronds. The [[pinnation|pinnae]] have curved, finely-toothed segments. The plant derives its common name from the linked [[sorus|sori]] on the undersides of the fronds.<ref name=RHSAZ>{{cite book|title=RHS A-Z encyclopedia of garden plants|year=2008|publisher=Dorling Kindersley|location=United Kingdom|isbn=978-1-4053-3296-5|pages=1136}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Plants for a future (PFAF) - Woodwardia radicans|url=http://www.pfaf.org/user/Plant.aspx?LatinName=Woodwardia+radicans|access-date=15 May 2013}}</ref>

The [[Binomial nomenclature|specific epithet]] ''radicans'' means "with stems that take root", referring to rooting plantlets appearing at the tips of the fronds.<ref name=RHSLG>{{cite book|last=Harrison|first=Lorraine|title=RHS Latin for gardeners|year=2012|publisher=Mitchell Beazley|location=United Kingdom|isbn=978-1-84533-731-5|pages=224}}</ref>

This plant is cultivated as an ornamental, and in the UK has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web|title=''Woodwardia radicans''|url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/19130/Woodwardia-radicans/Details|publisher=Royal Horticultural Society|access-date=17 March 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf | title = AGM Plants - Ornamental | date = July 2017 | page = 108 | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | access-date = 10 March 2019}}</ref> Unlike its hardier cousin ''[[Woodwardia unigemmata]]'', it is prone to frost damage and requires protection in colder areas.<ref>{{cite web | url = http://architecturalplants.com/plants/id/woodwardia-unigemmata | title = Woodwardia unigemmata | publisher = Architectural Plants | access-date = 10 March 2019}}</ref>
